plan: Queue support as primary. It is Willy's best role at 51.3% over 355 games (overall is 50.7%). Set midlane as secondary, not the other way around.
Stop queueing offlane: 42.1% over 159 games is costing real VP. When auto-filled there, play the safest comfort pick, not a learning pick.
Two-hero rule for the climb: Zinx and Lt. Belica. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Willy wins about 4.1 and 4.0 more games per 100 on them.
Willy's champion pool is 13+ heroes wide and the top three are only 44% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Willy is at 546 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 903 — Platinum-level rating has been touched once already; this is a consistency problem, not a ceiling problem.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Willy is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 74%. Past 32: 50%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
insights.receipt: wins 17 of 23 short games vs 7 of 14 long ones, recent sample

insights.title: Willy is running hotter than the career line
insights.finding: The last 20 games are 70% against a 51% career. Whatever changed recently, keep it.
insights.receipt: 14/20 recent wins vs 50.7% over 1276 career games

insights.title: Mr_Meat31 brings out Willy's best
insights.finding: Willy's record alongside Mr_Meat31 is 54% over 369 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.

insights.title: Gadget is the long-term relationship
insights.finding: 230 games on Gadget at 50.2% — the field averages 51.5%. The comfort is real; the edge is not there yet — worth studying top builds.

insights.title: For the group chat
insights.finding: 1 pentakill in real 5v5s and a longest spree of 23 (plus 1 more in ARAM and brawls — the group chat can rule on whether those count). Willy has receipts.
